summary: Iteration 6 (finite per-player furniture inventory) tested end-to-end. Added new backend test suite test_furniture_inventory.py (8 tests) covering starter kit, backfill, place decrement/no-op, pickup refund (including absent-type refund), repeatable buy, wallet scoping, and reconnect persistence. Updated test_economy_farming.py to replace legacy 'unlocked' assertions with 'furniture' and reworked buy_furniture test for repeatable semantics (including place drop-to-0 removal from dict). All 36 pytest tests pass (8 new + 7 updated economy + 3 fishing + 11 decor_rotation + 5 houses_zones + 2 others). Frontend E2E via Playwright confirmed: starter counts render (chair=5, flower=6, bed=3), slot-count-chair updates 5->4 on E, 4->5 on F pickup, drains to 0 after 5 places, 6th press E raises 'out of' toast with no placement and badge turns red/dim.
critical_code_review_comments: IslandGame.jsx is 1357 lines — consider splitting into smaller modules (toolbar, shop, decor, canvas renderer) for maintainability.
server.py places/pickups do an extra get_state DB roundtrip per action; acceptable at current scale but could be optimized by caching player_state during a WS session.
pickup refunds inventory regardless of who placed the item (by design per spec). Confirmed via tests. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows (place decrement, pickup refund, drain-to-zero + out-of toast)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own room via POST /api/rooms/create (TEST_ prefixed). test_buy_furniture_is_repeatable_and_stacks seeds bells=1000 directly in Mongo for one test player.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite comprehensive and green. Shop UI opens by walking into the Nook Shop zone (data-testid=shop-modal, shop-tab-buy, buy-furniture-<id>) not by a direct button; next FE tests can trigger shop by moving player onto the shop door tile. Furniture wallet field is a dict keyed by type with value counts; types at 0 are removed from the dict.
